verdict.rationale: Chronicle's marketing llms.txt claims real-time monitoring of production agents with autonomous fix and rollback, which is a background autonomous capability the product itself runs. However, it is a single thin claim. The SDK 'automate workflows' line is a developer building block, not user-configurable background automations. missing for 10: documented user-defined automations or triggers, recurring schedules or background job configuration, first-party docs detailing how autonomous fix/rollback is set up, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
